mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. This mechanism is always active during normal monetary policy cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 7.5% indicates economic distress and reduced consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in 60% or more of instances where UNRATE > 7.5.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) and stable or falling interest rates (FEDFUNDS) signal delayed monetary policy response, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of rising CPIAUCSL and stable FEDFUNDS fails to produce negative returns in 60% or more of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 230), the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten policy aggressively, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of periods when CPIAUCSL > 230.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 900 thousand units signal weak residential demand and broader economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in 60% or more of instances where HOUST < 900.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a rapidly deteriorating labor market, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of declining PAYEMS and rising UNRATE fails to produce negative returns in 60% or more of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong residential fixed investment (RSAFS) reflects robust consumer demand and economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. This mechanism is always active during normal growth cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when RSAFS is above its 12-month average.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 98 (INDPRO) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, signaling economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in 60% or more of instances where INDPRO < 98.
